title: How to Become Financially Free as a Business Owner
meta_description: How to become financially free as a business owner: manage your time deliberately, delegate what you dislike, become mobile, and hold six months in cash.
h1: How to Become Financially Free as a Business Owner
hero_subtitle: A practical guide to the freedom that comes before the money does.

intro.answer: Financial freedom is not about working harder or reaching a higher net worth. Jason Graystone, who got there before 30, describes it as coming from a free mind rather than a bigger number.

image.alt: A construction business owner working towards financial freedom

intro.roadmap: This guide covers the three things Jason found useful on the way there: managing time deliberately, delegating the work you dislike, and making yourself mobile. Plus the simpler habit he pointed to alongside them.

briefing.title: Six Months in Cash Changes How You Think
briefing.intro: Of everything in this conversation, the most immediately usable is also the least glamorous. Holding six months of living costs in cash does nothing for your net worth and a great deal for your judgement.

panels.heading: Why does a cash buffer matter so much?
paragraphs: Because it takes the pressure off, and pressure is what makes owners take work they should refuse and hold on to work they should delegate.
It changes your outlook enough that you start exploring opportunities in the business rather than defending against problems. That shift is available long before the income is passive.

panels.heading: The three that build the rest
paragraphs: In order, because each one makes the next one possible.
steps: Manage time deliberately, and replace your own work with systems where you can.
Delegate what you dislike, working out what income you need in order to do it.
Become mobile, which Jason puts at 70% of being free.
Then work on making the income more passive.

review.label: The distinction
review.text: An income generated by systems that do not rely on you working is a different thing from a high income. Only one of them survives you taking a month off.
